title: 🔴 Live: Russia says it fired Oreshnik hypersonic missile in massive attack on Ukraine
contentText: Russia on Friday said it targeted Ukraine’s infrastructure with a hypersonic Oreshnik missile as part of a massive overnight attack. The attack on Kyiv killed four people and injured at least 22, according to local authorities. The strikes came shortly after Moscow denounced a Western plan to station peacekeeping troops in Ukraine after a ceasefire agreement. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.
